(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define (colors-reading grid)
    (remove-duplicates
     (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
             (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p)))
                  (grid-positions grid)))))
  (define (border-cells-for grid color)
    (let* ((cells (find-color grid color))
           (a (first cells))
           (b (second cells))
           (r0 (min (first a) (first b)))
           (r1 (max (first a) (first b)))
           (c0 (min (second a) (second b)))
           (c1 (max (second a) (second b))))
      (for*/list ((r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1)))
                  (c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1)))
                  #:when (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1)))
        (list r c))))
  (define (paired-colors grid)
    (filter (lambda (color) (= (length (find-color grid color)) 2))
            (colors-reading grid)))
  (define (touches? grid color border)
    (ormap (lambda (p) (if (member p border) #t #f))
           (find-color grid color)))
  (define (paint-border out source color)
    (paint-cells out (border-cells-for source color) color))
  (let ((paired (paired-colors g)))
    (if (= (length paired) 0)
        g
        (let* ((controller (first paired))
               (candidates (rest paired))
               (controller-border (border-cells-for g controller))
               (after-a (paint-border g g controller))
               (touched (filter (lambda (color)
                                  (touches? g color controller-border))
                                candidates))
               (k (length touched)))
          (if (or (= k 0) (> k (length candidates)))
              after-a
              (paint-border after-a g (list-ref candidates (- k 1)))))))))
